introHtml: Dri Duck headwear is built for durability and comfort, with moisture-wicking fabrics that keep you cool on the job or at outdoor events. Whether you're outfitting a construction crew or branding for a trade show, these caps hold up to frequent washing and heavy use. The DRI DUCK Mining Cap, for example, offers a structured fit with a pre-curved brim and adjustable closure. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that lasts.
